jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff | Data Engineering, Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

At Poesis, we're building an AI-native investment firm where data quality directly shapes what our models learn and the decisions they make. Financial data is complex, and making it accurate, consistent and reliable at scale is one of our most important engineering challenges. As a Member of Technical Staff focused on data engineering, you'll build reliable autonomous AI agents that detect and resolve complex data issues and strengthen the foundation of our investment process. This is an opportunity to pioneer a new approach to financial data engineering, with AI at the core of how data systems are built and operated.

Challenges You'll Work On

  • Build reliable autonomous agents that detect, investigate and resolve financial data errors, knowing when to escalate to humans.

  • Tackle point-in-time accuracy, survivorship bias and other challenges that can undermine financial models.

  • Investigate and resolve complex data integrity issues, from conflicting prices and corporate actions to inconsistent security identifiers.

  • Build scalable pipelines to integrate new financial datasets and ensure consistency across sources.

About You

  • You have deep, hands-on experience building production data pipelines and working with financial data at a quantitative investment firm, data provider or similar environment.

  • You have experience with Bloomberg, S&P Capital IQ, FactSet, LSEG/Refinitiv, MSCI Barra, or similar data providers.

  • You have tackled complex financial data issues involving corporate actions, security mapping and point-in-time accuracy, and understand their impact on backtesting and risk models.

  • You can independently troubleshoot complex data issues, work with vendors when needed and develop practical solutions.

  • You've built AI agents or are excited to develop autonomous systems that solve complex, real-world problems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, AWS, or related technologies.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA. Relocation allowance available.

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

Current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff | Agentic AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

 

About the Role

At Poesis, we are pioneering AI for investing, opening the door to improved alpha discovery, higher quality decision-making and intelligent risk management. AI agents are a core part of how we make this a reality and we’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help lead our agentic efforts. The work sits at the intersection of frontier models and production engineering, exploring what new models and harnesses make possible and turning those capabilities into real systems. This is a unique opportunity to help define how frontier AI is used in investing and shape the technical direction of our agent platform from an early stage.

 

Challenges You'll Work On

  • Design and build the architecture behind a scalable, reliable agent platform that evolves as models advance

  • Design and build agent-driven workflows and systems for complex investment problems.

  • Develop evaluation, observability and feedback systems that make agents more reliable and capable over time.

  • Solve the infrastructure and deployment challenges of running agents reliably in production.

 

About You

  • You’ve built agent systems at a frontier AI lab, agentic startup, top fund, big tech company, or similar.

  • You’ve deployed agents in production and know what it takes to make them reliable.

  • You have experience with orchestration, tool use, context management and grounding.

  • You understand agent failure modes and have built the evaluations and observability needed to diagnose and improve them.

  • You understand financial markets and have a strong interest in investing.

  • You have a BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with unstructured financial data and data providers (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv).

  • Experience with agent safety, sandboxing or guardrails in high-stakes environments.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA. Relocation allowance available.

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

Current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff | Machine Learning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

At Poesis, machine learning and artificial intelligence open the door to improved alpha discovery, higher quality decision-making and intelligent risk management. We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff (Machine Learning) to build the models, signals, and evaluation tools that make this possible. This is an opportunity to test new ideas against complex, real-world financial data and see the impact of your work on actual investment decisions.

Challenges You'll Work On

  • Find predictive signals in large financial, fundamental and alternative datasets.

  • Design experiments and evaluations that separate real improvements from noise.

  • Build rigorous, reproducible ML research systems for fast experimentation.

  • Turn promising research into production models and signals that hold up over time.

  • Use real-world outcomes to understand where models and agents can improve.

About You

  • You’ve worked at a frontier AI lab, agentic startup, high-growth technology company, leading investment manager, or similar organization.

  • You’ve developed, evaluated, and deployed ML models in production.

  • You understand how models fail, how evaluation design shapes outcomes and how to distinguish promising results from noise.

  • You have strong quantitative judgment and experience working with large, complex datasets.

  • You can take ownership of open-ended research problems and use evidence to decide what to pursue next.

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA. Relocation allowance available.

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

Current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing ML or AI systems using financial, fundamental, alternative, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with quantitative investing, portfolio construction, or risk management.

  • Experience applying modern AI systems to financial documents (filings, transcripts, etc).

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff | Quantitative Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional Member of Technical Staff (Quantitative Finance) to work alongside our CEO, Chief Scientist, and AI and engineering teams on the quantitative systems behind our investment process. You’ll prepare large financial datasets, design and implement models and agents, and build tools for testing and evaluation. This is an opportunity to work close to the research itself, moving new ideas from experiment to production, and seeing your work inform investment decisions.

Challenges You'll Work On

  • Turn financial research and model prototypes into robust production systems.

  • Make complex financial data reliable enough for rigorous modeling and investment research.

  • Build scalable, reproducible systems for feature generation, backtesting and model evaluation.

  • Stress-test models and signals to understand what holds up and what breaks down.

  • Help solve the engineering challenges of moving research quickly from experiment to production.

About You

  • You’ve built infrastructure, data pipelines, or analytical tools for developing and evaluating financial models or trading strategies.

  • You enjoy working with complex linguistic and numerical data and producing rigorous, reproducible analysis.

  • You have strong quantitative foundations and can reason clearly about statistical and modeling problems.

  • You balance iteration speed with engineering quality and know when a prototype needs to be made more robust.

  • You can explain technical findings and experimental results to leadership and technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • You have a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Finance, or a related quantitative field.

Nice to Have

  • Full-time experience in finance, data science, or machine learning engineering.

  • Experience integrating professional financial data from Bloomberg, CapIQ, FactSet, or Refinitiv into quantitative research workflows.

  • Familiarity with portfolio optimization, risk modeling, or financial time series.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA. Relocation allowance available.

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

Current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis
